gameDescriptionHtml:
Global Domination – Ball-Style: The world is divided, and it’s up to you to redraw the map. Step into the round shoes of your favorite Countryball and embark on the ultimate mission: conquer and unify all 195 countries. Whether through brute force or slick diplomacy, it’s time to roll your way to victory.

Income Per Second – Build Your Power: In Countryballs: Power Protocol, time is literally money. Your income grows every second. Upgrade your industries, boost trade, and manage global assets to fuel your expansion. The more countries you control, the more your economy explodes. Smart decisions lead to total domination.
Conquer with Force: Train cartoony armies, deploy tanks, jets, submarines, and missile systems – and when diplomacy fails, drop the nukes. Dominate the battlefield with over-the-top firepower, all wrapped in classic Countryball humor.
Control with Influence: Spread your faith across borders and watch nations fall under your spiritual charm. Use religion as a tool of power – win hearts, shift ideologies, and unify the world without firing a single shot.
Your Goal: Total World Control: No peace treaties. No second chances. Only one Countryball can become the supreme global ruler. Will you win by fear, friendship, or sheer strategy?
A Strategy Game That Doesn’t Take Itself Too Seriously: Countryballs: Power Protocol blends grand strategy with idle mechanics, packed with humor, history, and global absurdity. It’s world conquest where even the smallest Countryball can redraw the map – with enough upgrades and audacity.

Game Features

  • Control over 195 unique Countryballs.
  • Upgrade your real-time income and economy.
  • Balance war, influence, and diplomacy.
  • Each Countryball has a distinct look and national personality – no customization needed.
  • Laugh (or cry) as global events spiral into madness.
  • Built for strategy fans and meme lovers alike.
